session.title: Connect with E-Flux session token
session.description:
1. Sign in to https://dashboard.e-flux.io using Chrome on a computer.

2. In the same tab, open the console with **⌘ + ⌥ + J** on Mac or **Ctrl + Shift + J** on Windows/Linux.

3. Run in the console: `copy(sessionStorage.getItem('e_flux_jwt') || localStorage.getItem('e_flux_jwt'))`

4. Return here and paste the token from your clipboard into the field below. Do not share this token; it grants access to your account. See the README for details and an option without a command.
